evals.prompt: Planeje uma feature que atravessa banco, API e interface, com dependências e critérios de aceite claros.
evals.expected_output: A tiered plan with discovery, design, task ownership, dependencies and phase gates.

evals.prompt: Use /plan for a bounded L3 change in one domain. The desired outcome, constraints and reuse are already clear; give the design, not implementation.
evals.expected_output: The project-planner writes the concise inline L3 design. No plan file, evaluator or extra agent is used.

evals.prompt: For /plan, prepare an L4 implementation plan. Repository evidence and decisions are supplied. State who authors the spec and PLAN.md, who owns GATE 1, and when execution may start.

assertions.check: regex: (?is)(?:before|until|waits for|aguarda).{0,80}(?:execution approval|approval for execution|aprovação para executar)

positive: The `graph-powers:project-planner` authors `spec.md`; a separate `graph-powers:evaluator` owns independent Mode 1 GATE 1. After the design transition is approved, `graph-powers:project-planner` authors `PLAN.md`. L4 stops with the plan; Phase C waits for execution approval.

O `graph-powers:project-planner` escreve a spec; um `graph-powers:evaluator` independente faz o GATE 1 Mode 1. Depois da aprovação da transição de design, o planner escreve `PLAN.md`. A Phase C espera pela aprovação de execução.
negative: The project-planner reviews its own spec at GATE 1, then writes PLAN.md and starts implementation immediately.
A main agent writes the plan and skips the independent GATE 1 review.

evals.prompt: For an L4 /implement objective with no plan, state the route before any writer.
evals.expected_output: /implement hands off once to /plan --plan-only and stops before Phase C; there project-planner authors Phase A and Phase B and a separate evaluator Mode 1 review precedes any lease or writer.

positive: `/implement` hands off once to `/plan` and stops before Phase C. There `graph-powers:project-planner` authors Phase A and Phase B, and a separate `graph-powers:evaluator` Mode 1 reviews the plan before lease or writer.

O `/implement` encaminha uma vez para `/plan` e para antes da Fase C. Lá o `graph-powers:project-planner` prepara a Phase A e a Phase B; o `graph-powers:evaluator` faz Mode 1 antes de lease ou writer.
negative: Skip the planner and let the implementation agent plan during the first writer wave.
/implement runs Phase A, Phase B and Phase C in the same turn and closes with /verify loop.
